name: Stability Ball Push-Up
steps: Grip the upper sides of a stability ball with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and walk your feet back into a straight plank position.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly to keep the ball steady underneath your chest.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso to lower your chest smoothly toward the top of the ball.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your arms back to full lockout while keeping the ball stable.
tips: Widen your stance for greater balance or bring your feet closer together to increase core demand.
Keep your body in one rigid line from head to heels instead of letting your lower back sag.
